other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan but cannot be a resident of the Municipal Corporation, Municipal Council, or Municipality of the district where they are studying
Parent/guardian must not own a house in the city or town where the student is studying
Student must not be residing in a government‑run hostel
Student must be regularly enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at a government college located at the district level
Benefit is available for a maximum of five years per student
Eligibility category noted in source: Scheduled Caste (SC)
Eligibility category noted in source: Scheduled Tribe (ST)
Eligibility category noted in source: Most Backward Class (MBC)
Eligibility category noted in source: Economically Weaker Section (EWS)
benefits_summary: Provides ₹2,000 per month for up to 10 months each academic year, for a maximum of five years per student.
